title: Implement @sevenpico/cdk-construct-sfn-error-notification
description:
Compose cdk-construct-sqs-queue with Step Functions to deliver error notifications to a queue. Depends on task 005 (sqs-queue) and task 012 (step-functions) being done. Read spec/construct-sfn-error-notification.md and the source Terraform module linked in the spec. GitHub issue #17.

Workflow:
1. Pattern Specialist verifies all dependency constructs are already merged to develop.
2. Pattern Specialist creates a feature branch: git checkout -b feat/{package-name} develop
3. Pattern Specialist implements: pure functions in {name}-fns.ts, thin Construct class in {name}.ts, BDD tests, package README.
4. Pattern Specialist compiles: cd packages/{name} && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json --noEmit
5. Pattern Specialist runs tests: cd packages/{name} && ../../node_modules/jest-cli/bin/jest.js --no-coverage (must pass)
6. Pattern Specialist pushes branch and opens PR against develop: gh pr create --base develop --title "feat({name}): implement {package}"
7. Code Reviewer reviews the PR on GitHub. MUST run all tests — all must pass. Checks: JSII compliance, functional architecture, spec fidelity, README accuracy.
8. QA Engineer reviews the PR test suite on GitHub. MUST verify tests pass. Checks: full composed pattern coverage including enabled:false.
9. Lead Engineer merges the PR to develop after all approvals.

Task is done only when the PR is merged to develop with all three review phases complete and all tests passing.
